name: Crossroads
district: Prologue (the Town Hall war room), the Public Library, the School District, the Community Clinic, Fire & EMS Dispatch and the Regional Airport
blurb: A week after Town Hall, two offers: run the region’s incident response programme as IR manager, or join the outside firm as principal DFIR consultant. Choose once; the Public Library is first, then the School District, the Community Clinic, Fire & EMS Dispatch and the Regional Airport.
